§10. Strike-and-insert section

The applicable period under this section is the 15-year period beginning on the date of enactment.

(Pub. L. 99–1, Jan. 1, 2020, 100 Stat. 1.)

§20. Unchanged section

This section is not amended in the proof window and must remain identical.

(Pub. L. 99–1, Jan. 1, 2020, 100 Stat. 1.)
